meta.title: Codex ↔ DSH Project Bridge
meta.description:
Local messaging, status queries and conversation creation between Codex and DSH. Register projects, not individual conversations. Uses local interfaces and the official Codex CLI; no cloud relay.

Open DSH normally and enable the plugin; no dedicated launcher is needed. Configure the Codex path and register a project before first use. See README.en.md.

New DSH conversations follow the app permission defaults unless full access is explicitly configured locally. Ask an existing Codex conversation to create new Codex work; CLI creation does not guarantee sidebar visibility. Permissions and workflow guides are in docs/.
Native internal coordination and low-permission worker callbacks in DSH require a separate plugin.
